description: Connects a laboratory test to the anatomical structure or body fluid that is itself the analyte being measured or characterized, using the LOINC Component axis. Examples include urine appearance and color, cerebrospinal-fluid appearance, and serum viscosity.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data source attribution; ["LOINC"] for this relationship.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory codes with CLASSTYPE = 1 and status ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED; DEPRECATED codes are excluded. Targets are Anatomy entities represented by UBERON identifiers. Challenge agents are excluded from analyte relationships.
source_contributions.description: Represents the anatomical analyte on the Component axis; the specimen in which a measurement is taken is represented separately by MEASURES_IN_CLmiA. Includes identifier-based anatomical mappings, curated LLM mappings for otherwise unresolved analytes, and manual curation for selected tests characterizing urine, cerebrospinal fluid, or serum.
